notes:
Account background: mid-market SaaS (B2B product analytics) -- shipping in-app help, insights, and agent features. Product team owns roadmap; infra team owns procurement. Two primary drivers: (1) improve conversion of trial→paid by adding an in-app, low-latency assistant, (2) add semantic search across customer docs for support.

Recent timeline:
- 2026-01-22: Intro call (Alex) w/ Head of Product (Maya Lind) + Eng Director (Jonas Petrov). Captured high-level goals. "Need predictable unit economics before we commit to Dedicated."
- 2026-02-05: Demo of Hosted API (Alex + SE Priya). Ran quick live prompts; product liked latency but asked about burst capacity.
- 2026-02-18: POC scoping call. Agreed to 3-week POC: chat flows + embeddings index for top 200k docs. Target: p95 latency <150ms for chat (first token) and 40 qps sustained for embedding batch jobs overnight.
- 2026-02-25: Cost-optimization prep meeting with SE Priya. Decided to run a workshop on batching, KV prefix caching, and quantization profiles. Priya to produce unit-cost model. (linked fireflies ff_20260225_costworkshop_prep)
- 2026-03-01: Sent initial cost model (Gmail thread-CAJx9b1k_crestview_eval). Product team asked for clearer comparison Hosted vs Dedicated with reserved capacity pricing + burst.
- 2026-03-04: Security call with infra and security ops. Asked for SOC2 attestation, SSO/SAML flow, KMS integration, and residency for EU customers. Legal requested DPA tweak (shared with Alex).

Use-case / requirements summary:
- Workloads: chat assistant (session-state, long contexts), embeddings (semantic search), reranking for search results.
- Perf targets: chat p95 <150ms first token under normal load, tail mitigation strategy for spikes; embeddings throughput: ability to encode 200k docs within 24-48h window; reranking latency budget 50-100ms per query.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market CPO expects < $200k incremental ARR cost to justify Dedicated; wants unit cost model showing per-1M tokens cost delta Hosted → Dedicated; aim to reduce per-token inference cost by 30-50% via batching/caching/quantization.
- Model preferences: open-model-first approach; prefer reproducible quantized variants; fallback to smaller high-accuracy models for latency-critical routes.
- Routing/fallback: automatic fallback to lower-cost replica when Dedicated saturated; multi-region failover for EU.
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, KMS for keys, audit logs retained 1 year, EU data residency for EU customers.

Workshop & POC specifics planned:
- Week 1: baseline run on Hosted API (sample traffic) to capture real token distribution and latency profile.
- Week 2: cost workshop w/ SEs focused on continuous batching settings, prefix KV caching patterns for chat sessions, and recommended quantization profiles (8-bit vs 4-bit) with quality vs cost tradeoffs. Deliverable: per-route unit economics sheet + suggested config.
- Week 3: short Dedicated smoke POC (small reserved pool) to validate predicted cost reductions and p95 latency targets.

Stated quotes and signals:
- "We can move to Dedicated if we get 30–40% unit cost drop and no regression in p95 latency." — Maya Lind, Head of Product.
- Strong signal: team approved budget for POC, but procurement requires vendor SOC2 and DPA terms.

Open questions for Redwood:
- Will Dedicated autoscaling support rapid daytime spikes (e.g., 3x traffic) without >2s tail?
- Can we produce a deterministic unit-cost model per 1M tokens for both Hosted and Dedicated with assumed batching/caching knobs?
- Roadmap ask: easier toggles in Console to test quantization profiles per-route during POC.

Next steps (short):
- 2026-03-06: Run Hosted baseline capture (Alex/Priya) — collect token histograms.
- 2026-03-10: Run 2-hr cost-optimization workshop (Priya + infra + product) — finalize unit economics.
- 2026-03-20: Deliver POC perf/cost report and recommended Dedicated sizing.
